video_title: Kon Knueppel: Inside the Milwaukee Native & Charlotte Hornets Star’s Amazing Rookie Year & Offseason

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his rookie season growth and team trust
quotes.excerpt: the trust that teammates and coaches put in me early on really helped spur that along
quotes.quote: I was going to throw my all into it and see how big of a role I could carve out for myself. I think the trust that teammates and coaches put in me early on really helped spur that along and just made me more comfortable. I was able to find my footing pretty early when we had some injuries and guys go down where I had to play a bigger role. And then once we had all the guys back, that trust from them was still there. So, it just allowed me to keep growing and keep getting better throughout the season.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his 32-point game against Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I came home and obviously my teammates came to dinner at my parents' house the night before
quotes.quote: It was awesome. I came home and obviously my teammates came to dinner at my parents' house the night before, so that was fun. A cool experience to kind of show them where I grew up and then obviously we were sitting at the tray right across from the five serves, so I couldn't really sleep. I was so pumped to play in Milwaukee and just be home. And then obviously the game started and I got two early fouls, so I was out early in the first quarter and they threw me back in there and then just got going from there. Obviously would have liked to win, had a big shot three-pointer to tie it and send it to OT, but just kind of a tough one, the Bucks ended up beating us, but it was a special night.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his experience doing the NBA rookie transition program
quotes.excerpt: the NBA was on NBC for a lot of games this year, so Fallon's on NBC
quotes.quote: The NBA was on NBC for a lot of games this year, so Fallon's on NBC and they wanted to, they kind of did it throughout the season where they'd bring somebody through from a team that's playing in New York, playing the Knicks or the Nets. And the Hornets wanted me to do it, so I was like really, I didn't really want to do it. I was really nervous and I was like, I don't really want to, but then after doing it, I was like, oh, that was pretty, that was pretty cool.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on the importance of avoiding foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: foul trouble is the worst because you're taking yourself out of the game for stupid reasons
quotes.quote: Foul trouble is the worst because you're taking yourself out of the game for stupid reasons. I think in that game, I got like a stupid, like it was a bad call and then I got one where it was a dumb, dumb foul on my part. Like why was I, I can't necessarily remember specifically what I, what I did, but that was like, that's always like a real number one, don't get in foul trouble. That's my dad's only rule. Like don't whine, don't complain, good body language, don't, don't foul. Don't foul out. I want to see you play.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his approach to long-term improvement
quotes.excerpt: I just like focusing on today, what can I do to get better today
quotes.quote: I just like focusing on today, what can I do to get better today. And stacking that over a long period of time has gradually gotten me to the point where I am right now.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on the Hornets' recruiting challenges
quotes.excerpt: Charlotte has not done great recently with like in-state recruiting
quotes.quote: We'll see. I mean, they got to keep working hard. Charlotte has not done great recently with like in-state recruiting, so I feel like they, you know, try to, sometimes they, they stay out of it a little bit because, you know, it's tough to recruit in-state guys like heavy and, you know, kind of not, not land them. So, you know, they've been, they've been looking elsewhere for, for players recently.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his decision to commit to Duke
quotes.excerpt: it's a smaller school, so I was at the time, I don't necessarily feel this way anymore, but when I was getting recruited, I was a little intimidated by the bigger schools
quotes.quote: I think a big thing that was underrated about it was it's a smaller school, so I was at the time, I don't necessarily feel this way anymore, but when I was getting recruited, I was a little intimidated by the bigger schools. And so there's 6,000 undergrad at Duke, and so that, that was really, um, intriguing to me. I liked it and then all the other stuff that comes into it, I mean, it's for the most part, it's a basketball decision. So, um, I love, I love Scheyer, I have a really good relationship with him, um, but also the, the, um, just the, the program and what it is and, and what it's become and, um, playing, you know, on primetime TV all the time, I think that's really fun for a, any, any player to play on that stage. But ultimately I felt like it was the, the place where I would go and compete against the best players I could and every day in practice and that's where I'd get the most better. So, I felt like that was the right choice.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on NBA rules regarding shootarounds
quotes.excerpt: you don't do a shootaround on a back-to-back
quotes.quote: There's rules in NBA, like rules, you don't do a shootaround on a back-to-back. And then, if the game starts any time before 7:00, you also don't do shootaround. So, if it's, if the game starts at 6:30, the game starts at 6:30, it's like, all right, no shootaround today. It's very, very, the worst ones are road back-to-backs. So, we played in San Francisco, we played the Warriors, got smoked, lost by like 20. We didn't play well and we had to fly to Denver the next day, which is like, it's a long flight. Denver's airport is like 30 to 40 minutes from downtown Denver.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on the team's pre-game preparation
quotes.excerpt: we have Chapel like an hour before the game, talk about the game plan
quotes.quote: We have Chapel like an hour before the game, talk about the game plan. That was the first time we talk about the game plan. Those will send you clips the night before or that, that morning, they send us clips and then like what we're going to do, it wasn't really discussed until like 30 minutes on the clock. We go out there, win by 30. That's the, the difference of the, the NBA, but like some of that stuff is just like a war of against your body and your mind throughout, throughout an 82-game season.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his relationship with Jayson Tatum and other NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Jason Tatum was there, Grayson Allen, Mark Williams
quotes.quote: Most of the guys from my team were there, Shyer, our assistant coaches, um, Jason Tatum was there, Grayson Allen, um, Mark Williams, and then you had like people that work in that, in the NBA, Quinn Snyder who's coach of the Hawks, um, Mike Dunleavy, the GM of the, the Warriors. So, it was very, very, very cool, um, just to kind of talk to those people.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on the Bucks' comeback against the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: the Bucks were down 3-0, I believe, and won two in a row
quotes.quote: That was cool because that was when we were down, the Bucks were down 3-0, I believe, and won two in a row, coming back home. And obviously no teams ever come back 3-0 and we're like, we're coming back home, like we're going to win this game. And they lost by 60. And Giannis got ejected. I mean, if you're losing by 60, you might as well get ejected at that point. Those were like 55 points.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on his former Duke teammates in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I mean, we had Zion, Tyrese, Cooper, me, Cam Malawatch
quotes.quote: I mean, we had Zion, Tyrese, Cooper, me, Cam Malawatch, and then we had Malik Brown got drafted this year, Isaiah Evans got drafted this year. So that's seven NBA players on a team. And then you have Caleb Foster who's still there, Pat Ngongba who's still there, who are probably going to be NBA players. And so like that's a really, really loaded team. You think about going into practice with that every day, like you have no choice but to get better.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
quotes.summary_phrase: Kon Knueppel on the Hornets' front office and roster building
quotes.excerpt: the front office does a really good job of, you know, locking guys down
quotes.quote: The front office does a really good job of, you know, locking guys down. We see with Pratt and Lara, like just getting long-term contracts and, you know, we'll see how they, they develop. But, you know, locking down young talent and obviously our farm system's always talented. So, it's very cool how we can just kind of shuffle guys in and out even though, you know, we're obviously restricted with, with money. It'd be cool to see us spend a little bit more.

Um, and so we have a nice beach area right by like the public beach, so it's great.

quotes.speaker: Kon Knueppel
